#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool check(int* arr, int i, int end, int w) {
    if (i > end) return true;
    int d = arr[i];
    if (d != 0 && d != 1 && d != w && d != w - 1) return false;
    if (d == w || d == w - 1) arr[i + 1]++;
    return check(arr, i + 1, end, w);
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    int arr[40] = {0};
    int cntr = 0;
    while (m > 0) {
        arr[cntr++] = m % w;
        m /= w;
    }
    cout << (check(arr, 0, cntr, w) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
